changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwsocialhistory AS SELECT sh.id, sh.patient_id, sh.is_current_smoker, sh.smoke_start_date, sh.cigarette_amount, sh.cigarette_type, sh.is_previous_smoker, sh.smoke_quit_date, sh.exposure_to_second_hand_smoke, sh.alcohol_consumption, sh.type_of_alcohol, sh.alcohol_since_when, sh.substance_use, sh.route, sh.frequency, sh.physical_limitation, sh.diagnosed_eating_disorders, sh.created_by, sh.created_date, sh.last_modified_by, sh.last_modified_date, sh.status, sh.cancelled_by, sh.cancelled_date, sh.cancellation_reason FROM public.social_history sh;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwsocialhistory TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwsocialhistory FROM report_user;
